biography.value:
Fawful's Forces packet sheet — Vial-Flinger. Built by tools/build-forge-packets.py from the NPC Forge roster data/forge/fawfuls-forces.json (entry vial-flinger): Small humanoid (Beanish), Neutral Evil; CR 2 (proficiency +2, to hit +4 with DEX); AC 13 (leather apron), hit points 31 (7d6+7), speed 30 ft.. A GM scene kit for the Fawful's Forces article's present (1040 BF), not a filed event; the faction article stays the authority.

Every vat needs a bean to stir it. The Vial-Flingers are the garrison's chemists — the ones who brew the mustard for the sprayers, the gel for the snares and the red fizz that keeps a Furybean on its feet — and when the alarm sounds they come out of the cellars with the bandolier still on. They fight from the back, behind the troopers and the Fury-Bots, and throw.

Kill the flinger early or the fight goes on longer than it should: a fizz on a construct is ten hit points back, and a snare on a cleric is a round without healing. They are soft, they hate melee, and the smoke trick works once.

Role: alchemist skirmisher · tier: specialist · folder: Fawful's Furious Freaks / The Bean Garrison.

Art

Token plate portraits/fawfuls-forces/vial-flinger.png — NPC Forge render, seed 410008, cut from a flat #FF00FF field. Prompt: Clean cel-shaded cartoon character art in the style of Mario & Luigi RPG concept art, bold dark outlines, flat colours, simple shading. A small lime-green bean-shaped humanoid alchemist with a toothy grin, wearing a green pith helmet with brass goggles, a stained brown leather apron over a dark coat, a bandolier of coloured potion vials across the chest, brown boots, holding up a glowing flask. Full body, whole figure visible, three-quarter view, centred, isolated on a plain flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no border.

description.value: Ranged Weapon Attack: range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 acid damage and the target is mustarded (disadvantage on Stealth checks, Fawful's constructs have advantage on attack rolls against it, and the first fire damage it takes flares for an extra 1d6) until it or an ally uses an action to wipe it off.
Melee Weapon Attack: reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 + 2 piercing damage.

2/Day. The flinger lobs a vial of green gel at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by hardening gel until it escapes (DC 13 Strength check as an action, or 5 fire damage to the gel).

2/Day, bonus action. The flinger throws a red fizzing vial to one ally it can see within 30 feet. A Beanish ally gains 10 temporary hit points and deals +2 damage with its attacks until the end of its next turn; a Fawful construct regains 10 hit points instead.

1/Day, reaction. When it is hit by an attack the flinger drops a smoke vial at its feet: a 10-foot-radius sphere centred on it is heavily obscured until the start of its next turn, and it immediately moves up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

activation.condition: when the flinger is hit by an attack

description.value: The flinger carries a bandolier of vat-brewed vials. Each special vial (Snare Gel, Fury Fizz, Smoke Vial) is a separate use tracked on its own action; a creature that searches the body finds 1d4 intact Mustard Flasks (2d6 acid, thrown 20/60).
